events.statement: A native contemporaneous email records the sender's report that HAYA asked for case material to be passed toward Uría Madrid and that Javier González was involved in a later communication about continuing the proceeding. This does not establish the native HAYA instruction, Uría's client, a retainer or legal title.

After speaking with Uría, Cuatrecasas reported that Uría said it did not yet have instructions to take any action on behalf of HAYA. This is material counter-evidence against treating a HAYA mandate as established on that date.

Cuatrecasas reported that the local enforcement lawyer confirmed acting in the proceedings for SAREB rather than Bankia. Native court appearance and assignment records remain required for final capacity/title conclusions.

A contemporaneous record reports that the Administrador Concursal had spoken with Javier Rubio Sanz of Uría Menéndez. This does not by itself establish representation, conflict or improper information flow.
A Promontoria Holding 122 B.V. filing in Concurso 36/2012 is signed by Uría lawyers including Javier Rubio Sanz, establishing a separate primary-document Uría footprint in the insolvency record.

Preserved RICPE presentation materials describe Uría Menéndez Madrid and PwC in the project-processing/due-diligence architecture and attribute to José Acosta statements including 'libres de cargas' and Sun Park / €12m. Those statements are not independent proof of title or absence of charges.

RICPE certification describes Sun Park as at a very early study/negotiation stage and says complete legal, tax, financial, technical and insurance due diligence had not yet taken place because no letter of intent had been signed.
CAM filing supplies the RICPE certification into the relevant documentary record.

CaixaBank's defence in PO 1859/2023-9 identifies Raimon Tagliavini Sansa and David García Martín as counsel and expressly relies on LPB Concurso 36/2012 and the Administración Concursal record for standing and res judicata arguments. The pleaded consequences are not judicial findings.

The recovered connected Control 21 version requests reports/notes from Uría Menéndez, PwC and others concerning title, encumbrances, suitability, risks and the real scope of Sun Park in 2020–2021. The connected Decanato receipt supports reception/submission on 9 July 2026 and visibly records procedure no. 1901/2026, but does not independently establish byte-for-byte identity with the exact court-filed packet.
